terms.heading: Interest
terms.text: Interest accrues daily on the outstanding principal at the agreed rate and is payable monthly in arrears.

terms.heading: Prepayment
terms.text: The borrower may prepay all or part of the loan on any business day with five business days' notice.

terms.heading: Fees
terms.text: An arrangement fee is payable on signing and a commitment fee accrues on undrawn amounts.

terms.heading: Covenants
terms.text: The borrower will maintain a debt service coverage ratio of at least 1.25x, tested quarterly.

terms.heading: Events of default
terms.text: Non-payment, breach of covenant, insolvency and material adverse change are events of default.

terms.heading: Governing law
terms.text: This agreement is governed by the laws of the State of New York.

terms.heading: Notices
terms.text: Notices must be in writing and delivered to the addresses set out in the schedule.

terms.heading: Assignment
terms.text: The borrower may not assign its rights without the lender's prior written consent.
